name: Asset Alchemist
title: Sovereign Polish — Artwork Integrity & Cinematic UI
subtitle: Protected local video media, smarter cover previews and visual refinement
features: Fixed local Video Vault cover leaks: custom GIF/video art is removed from its independent cover database after the corresponding saved movie is successfully deleted.

Redesigned custom-cover rendering to list keys only, lazy-fetch large artwork when cards enter the viewport, and trim offscreen artwork from memory on iPhone without changing the original video library.
Added safe one-click cleanup for orphaned personal artwork with confirmation, cover count, and no video deletion.
Corrected the Media Publisher removal flow to commit the IndexedDB deletion before revoking existing image/video URLs or hiding the background.

Added Sovereign Polish, a lightweight violet/cyan/gold visual refresh for Command Center, library cards and personal-media controls, with better readable text, accessible focus and reduced-motion handling.

Preserved the existing 18 studios, home icon editor, app storage keys, personal video/movie metadata, large-file import behavior, current PWA installation, and the previous v3.7.0 offline cache as a rollback option.
Personal background/thumbnail backup restore now commits as one atomic IndexedDB transaction. If storage runs out mid-restore, existing saved artwork is retained rather than being partially cleared.
Desktop Video Vault now constrains its workspace width to the fixed studio rail, avoiding horizontally scrolled library controls appearing underneath sidebar navigation.
